verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service, so AR tracking is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented reporting surface covers only income statements, balance sheets, a P&L/Top Expenses dashboard and 1099 reports. The evidence never mentions invoicing, accounts-receivable aging reports or per-customer balances, and the QBO-native option describes Bench bookkeepers working inside the client's QuickBooks account rather than any AR capability Bench itself provides.
